name: Odysseus
description: Odysseus is a self-hosted AI workspace. It bundles chat, web search via SearXNG, and a ChromaDB vector store so you can run your own private AI environment with the LLM provider of your choice.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Odysseus admin password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Searxng secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-odysseus application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-odysseus
  # The main Odysseus AI workspace service
  big-bear-odysseus:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-odysseus
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: bigbeartechworld/big-bear-odysseus:2026.10.22@sha256:5bb9e5cde7cd238e2b9ca9f9bcbc461dea9eb66524b9112c302ff0d90b6ca3ee
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 7000 of the host to port 7000 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:7000"
    environment:
      # Process user ID
      - PUID=1000
      # Process group ID
      - PGID=1000
      # Require login to access the workspace
      - AUTH_ENABLED=true
      # Admin password (override via .env, default is insecure)
      - ODYSSEUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${SECRET_ODYSSEUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      # SearXNG search instance URL
      - SEARXNG_INSTANCE=http://searxng:8080
      # ChromaDB host
      - CHROMADB_HOST=chromadb
      # ChromaDB port
      - CHROMADB_PORT=8000
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Application data
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/app/data
      # Application logs
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/logs:/app/logs
    # Start order dependencies
    depends_on:
      searxng:
        condition: service_healthy
      chromadb:
        condition: service_started
    # Healthcheck for the Odysseus API
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:7000/api/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    networks:
      - big_bear_odysseus_network
  # Service name: chromadb
  # Vector database for Odysseus
  chromadb:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-odysseus-chromadb
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: chromadb/chroma:1.5.9@sha256:1e0b73a187a28757c572acba508c46f48c9e8b0acaf5c20e6d95cdedce1acdf6
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      # Disable anonymized telemetry
      - ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=FALSE
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # ChromaDB persistence
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/chromadb:/chroma/chroma
    networks:
      - big_bear_odysseus_network
  # Service name: searxng
  # Web search backend; settings seeded into the named volume on first run
  searxng:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-odysseus-searxng
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: searxng/searxng:2026.6.2-e964708c0@sha256:0872beb1d495d41f2dda73d7aea83746657afdd2be3010eb1b11f5a541555c9e
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Inline entrypoint seeds settings.yml (secret + html/json formats) into the volume
    entrypoint:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        set -eu
        if [ ! -s /etc/searxng/settings.yml ]; then
          secret="$${SEARXNG_SECRET:-}"
          if [ -z "$$secret" ]; then
            secret="$$(python -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))')"
          fi
          cat > /etc/searxng/settings.yml <<EOF
        use_default_settings: true
        server:
          secret_key: "$$secret"
        search:
          formats:
            - html
            - json
        EOF
        fi
        exec /usr/local/searxng/entrypoint.sh
    environment:
      # Base URL for SearXNG
      - SEARXNG_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080/
      # Optional fixed secret (auto-generated if empty)
      - SEARXNG_SECRET=${SECRET_SEARXNG_SECRET}
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # SearXNG config persistence
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/searxng:/etc/searxng
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    cap_add:
      - CHOWN
      - SETGID
      - SETUID
      - DAC_OVERRIDE
    # Healthcheck for the SearXNG service
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "python -c \"import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8080/', timeout=5).read(1)\""]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 6s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 10s
    networks:
      - big_bear_odysseus_network
  # Service name: ntfy
  # Optional notification service
  ntfy:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-odysseus-ntfy
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.34.0@sha256:901e14503d3f605f445be0e68f2ac71f0aa73391897ce6ceb599f8c48d8b3792
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Run the ntfy server
    command: serve
    # Ports mapping between host and container (bound to loopback by default)
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8091:80"
    environment:
      # Base URL for ntfy
      - NTFY_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8091
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # ntfy cache
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/ntfy:/var/cache/ntfy
    networks:
      - big_bear_odysseus_network
# Network configuration
networks:
  big_bear_odysseus_network:
    driver: bridge
notes: Set ODYSSEUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD before installing. The default password is insecure.
